SELECT r.id, r.report_no, r.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, r.category_id, pc.name AS category_name, r.description, r.province, r.city, r.district, r.address, r.urgency, r.status, r.handler_id, su.real_name AS handler_name, r.handle_remark, DATE_FORMAT(r.handle_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS handle_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time FROM rescue_report r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pet_category pc ON pc.id = r.category_id AND pc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = r.handler_id AND su.deleted = 0
r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = #{q.status} AND r.urgency = #{q.urgency} AND r.city = #{q.city}
AND (r.report_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC
